_comment: Vulcan reference calibration: model (h, v) mm at 1:72 -> page px (u, v) = A @ [h, v, 1]. Images are not in git (ref/ is ignored).

plan._source: Wikimedia Commons 'Avro Vulcan B.2 three-view silhouette.png' (GVG/PD), 1920 px thumbnail (user upload). Plan view, nose up. Span cols 57 to 970 = 469.9 mm: 0.5146 mm/px. Nose tip (no probe) row 88, tail row 875, centreline col 513.5.

side._source: Same sheet, starboard side view (nose right). Nose tip col 1840, row 632.5; tail col 1042: 798 px = 405 mm, 0.5075 mm/px (1% off the plan's scale).

front._source: Same sheet, head-on view. Span 888 px: 0.529 mm/px. Heights are drawn about 12% taller than in the side view (fin top above the belly: 179 px here, 166 px there), so v uses 2.1267 px/mm. Belly row 260 = z -20.6.

aw_plan._source: aerospaceweb.org Vulcan 3-view (vulcan_schem_01.gif, 466 x 334), enlarged x4 (Lanczos). Plan view, nose right. Low resolution (1.5 mm per source pixel at 1:72); scale from the span. Superseded by the Commons silhouette; kept as a second source.
